reason: The README describes a DSH plugin installer that adds a settings page for installing, hot-loading, persisting, updating, and removing dynamic plugins from uploaded packages or Git repositories.

summaries.zh: 为DSH提供插件安装页面，可从上传的清单文件或Git仓库安装、热加载、持久化管理和移除动态插件。
summaries.en: Adds a DSH settings page for installing, hot-loading, persisting, updating, and removing dynamic plugins from uploaded manifests or Git repositories.

capabilities: Installs dynamic plugins from uploaded manifest files or Git repository URLs
Executes plugin host and client code supplied by installed packages
Writes persistent plugin manifests and deployment changes under DSH_HOME
Can stop, restart, hot-load, update, and remove plugins and the installer
